roles.name: scout
roles.description: Ground the problem: known facts, definitions, open sub-questions.

roles.name: explorer
roles.description: Open independent branches and propose falsifiable hypotheses.

roles.name: adversary
roles.description: Attack claims: hidden assumptions, counterexamples, cheap falsification.

roles.name: experimentalist
roles.description: Run exact computational experiments and request deterministic verification.

roles.name: synthesizer
roles.description: Consolidate rounds, extract skills, record decisions.

safety.notes: Pure integer arithmetic, no network, no external state.
